candidate_source.candidate_rule: top-20 at every A[i,j] threshold in both foreign intermediate sales and foreign downstream input-share mass, excluding ROW

coefficient_orientation: A[i,j] = Z[i,j] / x[j], supplier i to using industry j

propagation_model.name: linear downstream fixed-coefficient exposure cascade
propagation_model.interpretation: q is a gross-output-normalised downstream exposure index under proportional input loss, fixed coefficients, no substitution, no inventories and linear retransmission. It is not a causal forecast, physical capacity solution or demand-side Leontief multiplier.

admissibility.action_if_failed: Do not compute or report empirical propagation outcomes; report the failed gate and redesign prospectively.

shock_design.application: one candidate node at a time; no joint shock in the primary analysis
shock_design.normalisation: candidate comparison uses per-unit amplification, which is invariant to shock magnitude in this linear model
shock_design.linearity_note: The 5%, 10% and 20% scenarios must scale exactly up to numerical tolerance; they are a model-consistency check rather than independent robustness evidence.

network_sensitivity.interpretation: diagnostic topology sensitivity only; thresholded matrices are not treated as alternative balanced ICIO systems

outcomes.foreign_propagated_exposure: sum over j outside shocked supplier country of x[j] * q[j]
outcomes.max_nonshocked_exposure_index: max q[j] over j != shocked node
outcomes.top_affected_nodes: top 20 by x[j] * q[j], with q[j], gross output, country and activity reported

ranking_outputs.secondary_supplier_ranking: descending unthresholded total output-equivalent exposure under the 10% shock
ranking_outputs.threshold_stability: Spearman across all seven candidates and top-3 Jaccard versus the unthresholded ranking

scientific_boundaries: No endogenous substitution, inventories, prices, capacity reallocation or recovery dynamics.
No claim that the simulated percentage is an observed or forecast real-world disruption magnitude.
No candidate may be added or removed after propagation results are inspected.
No threshold may replace the unthresholded matrix as primary after results are inspected.
